stem.text: A computer is used to detect the change of position of a switch.

To detect the change of position, the computer requires a potential difference (p.d.) of $0\,\text{V}$ to its input at one switch position and a p.d. of between $5\,\text{V}$ and $7\,\text{V}$ at the other switch position.
For each of the circuits, assume the battery has negligible internal resistance.
Which circuit provides an input voltage to the computer that enables it to detect the change of position of the switch?

A.alt: Circuit with a 9 V cell, a switch, a 1 kΩ resistor above a 1 kΩ resistor, and computer input voltage terminals across the lower resistor.

B.alt: Circuit with a 9 V cell, a switch, a 1 kΩ resistor above a 2 kΩ resistor, and computer input voltage terminals across the lower resistor.

C.alt: Circuit with a 9 V cell, a 2 kΩ resistor above a 500 Ω resistor, a switch in the lower branch, and computer input voltage terminals across the lower resistor.

D.alt: Circuit with a 9 V cell, a 500 Ω resistor above a 2 kΩ resistor, a switch in the lower branch, and computer input voltage terminals across the lower resistor.
